level_one.title: Zealous Glare
level_one.description: Shield Glare gains 1 additional charge, and deals 70% more damage.

level_four.title: Subdue
level_four.description: Hitting 2 or more Heroes at the same time with Punish increases the Slow to 70% and the Slow amount does not decay.  Quest: Hit 4 or more Heroes at the same time with Punish.  Reward: Punish always Slows by 70%.

level_seven.title: Conviction
level_seven.description: Gain 10% Movement Speed, increased to 20% while Condemn is charging up.

level_ten.title: Falling Sword
level_ten.description: Johanna leaps into the air for 2 seconds and she can steer the landing location by moving. While in the air, allies below Johanna are Unstoppable. Upon landing enemies hit take 225 (+4% per level) damage and are Stunned for 0.25 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: Holy Fury
level_thirteen.description: Deal 15 (+4% per level) damage per second to nearby enemies. Each Hero hit by Condemn increases this damage by 40% for 5 seconds.

level_sixteen.title: Holy Renewal
level_sixteen.description: Hitting enemy Heroes with Shield Glare reduce its cooldown by 1 second and heals for 5% of Johanna's maximum Health.

level_twenty.title: Blinded By The Light
level_twenty.description: Activate to grant nearby allied Heroes a Shield equal to 25% of their maximum Health for 3 seconds.  Hitting Heroes with Shield Glare reduces the cooldown of this Ability by 8 seconds.

level_one.title: Quarterback
level_one.description: Increases Frag Grenade's damage by 10% and its range by 45%.

level_four.title: Master Assassin
level_four.description: Passive: Increase Tychus's Attack Speed by 10%.  Reward: After getting 15 Takedowns, Tychus's Attack Speed is increased by an additional 15%.

level_seven.title: Relentless Soldier
level_seven.description: Being Stunned or Rooted grants 30 Armor for 3 seconds, reducing damage taken by 30%.

level_ten.title: Commandeer Odin
level_ten.description: Call down an Odin to pilot. The Odin deals increased Damage, has 100% increased Basic Attack range, and uses different Abilities. The Odin has 25 Armor and lasts 23 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: Spray 'n' Pray
level_thirteen.description: Overkill Slows enemy Movement Speed by 25% and its range is increased by 25%.

level_sixteen.title: Armor Piercing Rounds
level_sixteen.description: Each time Overkill hits an enemy, its damage against them is increased by 15%, stacking up to 60% bonus damage.

level_twenty.title: Big Red Button
level_twenty.description: Odin lasts 50% longer and Ragnarok Missiles also launches a Nuclear Missile which lands 2.5 seconds later, dealing 319 (+4% per level) damage in its area.

level_one.title: Aether Walker
level_one.description: Teleport costs no Mana. If Li-Ming hasn't taken damage in the last 3 seconds, Teleport's cooldown is decreased by 2 seconds. Casting Teleport causes Li-Ming's next cast of Magic Missiles to deal 10% bonus damage.

level_four.title: Triumvirate
level_four.description: If Arcane Orb hits an enemy Hero after traveling at least 50% of its base range, the cooldown is reduced by 5 seconds and 40 Mana is refunded.

level_seven.title: Calamity
level_seven.description: Teleport does 300 (+3% per level) damage to enemy Heroes near the destination.

level_ten.title: Disintegrate
level_ten.description: Channel a powerful beam, dealing 480 (+5% per level) damage over 2.6 seconds to enemies while they are in it. The direction of the beam changes with your mouse cursor position.

level_thirteen.title: Illusionist
level_thirteen.description: If Li-Ming loses more than 20% of her Health at once, its cooldown is instantly refreshed.  This effect has a 4 second cooldown.  Passive: Increases Teleport range by 50%

level_sixteen.title: Mirrorball
level_sixteen.description: Magic Missiles fires an additional 2 missiles, but its Mana cost is increased by 5.

level_twenty.title: Archon: Pure Power
level_twenty.description: Activate to enter Archon form, allowing Li-Ming to repeatedly use Disintegrate, but be unable to cast other Abilities.

level_one.title: Stormcaller
level_one.description: Increase the radius of Lightning Shield by 25%.  Quest: Each time Lightning Shield damages an enemy Hero, permanently increase Rehgar's Health by 2 and Mana by 1, stacking up to 200 times.

level_four.title: Electric Charge
level_four.description: The bearer of Lightning Shield Heals for 20% of the damage it deals to enemy Heroes, doubled if the bearer is Rehgar.  While Lightning Shield is damaging an enemy, its bearer gains 10% increased Movement Speed.

level_seven.title: Blood and Thunder
level_seven.description: Ghost Wolf attacks reduce Basic Ability cooldowns by 1.5 seconds and restore 4% of Rehgar's maximum Mana.

level_ten.title: Ancestral Healing
level_ten.description: After 1 second, heal an allied Hero for 1180 (+4% per level) Health.

level_thirteen.title: Earth Shield
level_thirteen.description: Lightning Shield gives Heroes a Shield that absorbs damage equal to 14% of their maximum Health for 3 seconds.

level_sixteen.title: Rising Storm
level_sixteen.description: Every time a Lightning Shield damages an enemy Hero, increase its damage by 10%. Stacks up to 15 times.  Passive: Increase the duration of Lightning Shield by 3 seconds.

level_twenty.title: Elemental Conduit
level_twenty.description: Activate to gain Lightning Shield and grant all nearby allied Heroes a Shield equal to 10% of their maximum Health for 5 seconds.  For up to 5 seconds after activating, hitting an enemy Hero with this effects' Lightning Shield gives nearby allies a Shield equal to 1.5% of their maximum Health for 5 seconds.

level_one.title: Tough As Nails
level_one.description: Every 16 seconds, gain 60 Physical Armor against the next enemy Hero Basic Attack, reducing the damage taken by 60%.  Stores up to 3 charges. Charges refresh 200% faster while Fury's Movement Speed bonus is active.

level_four.title: Shot Of Fury
level_four.description: Activate to gain 50 Fury. Usable while Whirlwinding.  Passive: After casting Seismic Slam, your next Basic Attack deals 40% more damage.

level_seven.title: Poisoned Spear
level_seven.description: Ancient Spear deals an additional 100% damage over 6 seconds.

level_ten.title: Leap
level_ten.description: Leap into the air, dealing 135 (+4% per level) damage to nearby enemies, and stunning them for 1.25 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: Mystical Spear
level_thirteen.description: Ancient Spear always pulls Sonya to the target location even if it doesn't hit an enemy. When used this way, Ancient Spear's cooldown is reduced by 5 seconds.

level_sixteen.title: Giant Slammer
level_sixteen.description: Basic Attacks and Seismic Slam deal an additional 1.5% of Heroes' maximum Health as damage and heal Sonya for 60% of the damage dealt.

level_twenty.title: Composite Spear
level_twenty.description: Increases Ancient Spear's range by 50%. Hitting an enemy Hero with Ancient Spear grants 25 Armor for 4 seconds.

level_one.title: Hyper Shift
level_one.description: Increase Phase Shift's healing by an additional 4% of the target's maximum Health. Nearby enemy Minion deaths reduce Phase Shift's cooldown by 0.5 second.

level_four.title: Magic Spit
level_four.description: Increase Basic Attack range by 1.1. Basic Attacks against Heroes reduce the cooldown of Soothing Mist by 4 seconds.

level_seven.title: Critical Mist
level_seven.description: Soothing Mist heals allied Heroes for 165 (+4% per level). Increase this healing by 140% if Soothing Mist removed a disabling effect from that ally.

level_ten.title: Blink Heal
level_ten.description: Teleport to a nearby ally. When teleporting to a Hero, heal them for 200 (+4% per level).  Stores up to 2 charges.

level_thirteen.title: Safety Dust
level_thirteen.description: Increase Pixie Dust's duration by 1 second. Soothing Mist and Blink Heal heal allies with an active Pixie Dust for 75% more.

level_sixteen.title: Critterize
level_sixteen.description: While Polymorphed, the target's Armor is reduced by 25, increasing the damage they take by 25%.

level_twenty.title: Faerie Protector
level_twenty.description: Activate to apply Pixie Dust to all nearby Heroes.  Passive: Pixie Dust always bounces back and applies to Brightwing.

level_one.title: Adrenaline Stimpack
level_one.description: Passive: While over 80% Health, gain 20% bonus Attack Speed and 10% bonus Movement Speed.  Activate to gain 85% Attack Speed and 25% Movement Speed for 5 seconds.

level_four.title: Incinerator Gauntlets
level_four.description: Increase Basic Attack area by 15%, and Basic Attack damage to Minions, Mercenaries, and Monsters by 40%.

level_seven.title: Nanomachine Coating
level_seven.description: Enemies standing in Oil Spills and Ignited Oil Spills have their Attack Speed reduced by 35% for 4 seconds.

level_ten.title: Bunker Drop
level_ten.description: After 0.5 seconds, deploy and enter a Bunker with 1435 (+4% per level) Health. Blaze and his allies can enter and exit the Bunker at will. While in the Bunker, occupants gain access to Flamethrower, dealing 150 (+4% per level) damage to enemies in a line.  Exiting the Bunker grants 25 Armor for 2 seconds. Bunkers last 10 seconds, or until destroyed.

level_thirteen.title: Collision Course
level_thirteen.description: Jet Propulsion's collision deals 260 (+4% per level) damage to the first enemy Hero hit.

level_sixteen.title: Thermal Protection
level_sixteen.description: Each enemy hit by Jet Propulsion grants 10 Armor for 3 seconds and reduces its cooldown by 1.25 seconds.

level_twenty.title: Burn Notice
level_twenty.description: Basic Attacks Slow enemies by 5% and deal an additional 18 (+4% per level) damage over 2.5 seconds. Stacks up to 5 times.

level_one.title: Shifting Meteor
level_one.description: Each time an enemy is hit by the same Living Meteor, they take 6% increased damage from it.  Quest: Hit 75 Heroes with Living Meteor.  Reward: After hitting 75 Heroes with Living Meteor, its duration is increased to 2.25 seconds, and it can be reactivated to change its direction once per use.

level_four.title: Fire Ward
level_four.description: When Living Meteor hits an enemy Hero, gain a charge of Spell Armor, reducing damage from the next enemy ability by 50%.  Stores up to 2 charges.

level_seven.title: Molten Power
level_seven.description: If Living Meteor hits enemy Heroes at least 5 times, reduce its cooldown by 7 seconds, and refund 30 Mana.

level_ten.title: Sulfuras Smash
level_ten.description: Hurl Sulfuras at the target area, landing after 0.75 seconds, dealing 250 (+4% per level) damage. Enemies in the center take 594 (+4% per level) damage instead and are Stunned for 0.5 seconds.  Quest: Hit 8 enemy Heroes in the center.  Mythic Reward: Sulfuras Smash gains an additional charge.

level_thirteen.title: Tempered Flame
level_thirteen.description: When Blast Wave damages an enemy Hero, gain a Shield equal to 100% of the damage dealt for 3 seconds.

level_sixteen.title: Meteor Bomb
level_sixteen.description: Living Meteor explodes at the end of its path, dealing 220 (+4% per level) damage. Enemies at its center take 30% increased damage.

level_twenty.title: Heroic Difficulty
level_twenty.description: Molten Core's range is increased by 100% at the start of its duration.  In addition, the cooldown of Molten Core is reduced by 110 seconds when used on a destroyed Fort or Keep.

level_one.title: Unrelenting Torment
level_one.description: Increase the damage of Shadow Dagger by 20% and increase its duration by 1 second.

level_four.title: Haunting Arrows
level_four.description: Black Arrows can now be activated to cause all Basic Attacks and Abilities to Stun Minions and Structures for 3 seconds. Lasts for 10 seconds. Basic Attacks against Structures reduce this cooldown by 3 seconds.

level_seven.title: Lost Soul
level_seven.description: Basic Attacks against Heroes and Structures with 3 stacks of Black Arrows reduce the cooldown of Shadow Dagger by 0.75 seconds, doubled against Heroes.

level_ten.title: Mind Control
level_ten.description: After 0.25 seconds, fire a missile that Mind Controls the first enemy Hero hit. Heroes hit are Silenced, Slowed by 30%, have 3 stacks of Black Arrows applied to them, and are forced to walk towards Sylvanas for 1.75 seconds.

level_thirteen.title: Remorseless
level_thirteen.description: Sylvanas's Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes with 3 stacks of Black Arrows shoot an untalented shot of Withering Fire. This shot of Withering Fire applies Black Arrows.  Increase Sylvanas's Basic Attack range by 1.

level_sixteen.title: Evasive Fire
level_sixteen.description: Hitting an enemy with Withering Fire grants 6% Movement Speed for 2 seconds, up to 30%. Basic Attacks refresh this duration.

level_twenty.title: Withering Barrage
level_twenty.description: Withering Fire applies Black Arrows, and Heroes hit by Withering Fire reduce its cooldown by 0.75 seconds.

level_one.title: Legion of Beetles
level_one.description: Beetles have 30 Spell Armor. Automatically spawn a Beetle every 12 seconds. Can be toggled on and off.

level_four.title: Bed of Barbs
level_four.description: Create a bed of spikes along Impale's path that Slows enemies by 25% and deals 21 (+4% per level) damage per second. Spikes persist for 3.5 seconds.

level_seven.title: Leeching Scarabs
level_seven.description: Beetles attacks deal 30% more damage and heal Anub'arak 50% of damage dealt if he is nearby.

level_ten.title: Cocoon
level_ten.description: Wraps target enemy Hero in a cocoon, rendering them unable to act or be targeted for 7 seconds. Allies of the Hero can attack the cocoon to break it and free them early.

level_thirteen.title: Burning Beetles
level_thirteen.description: Deal 21 (+4% per level) damage per second to nearby enemies. Beetles deal 6 (+4% per level) damage per second to nearby enemies.

level_sixteen.title: Beetle, Juiced
level_sixteen.description: Passive: Beetles gain 30% increased health.  Every 4th Basic Attack spawns a Beetle.

level_twenty.title: Rewind
level_twenty.description: Activate to reset the cooldowns of your Basic Abilities.
